svg.title: Scheduled return through a selected PCB activation
svg.desc: The dispatcher reads the target PCB and boundary from its kernel call frame, sets the target SP before the boundary, restores six registers from the PCB, then uses RTI on the selected process stack.

g.text: Scheduled return: restore registers from the PCB, then PC from the selected stack
Higher addresses at top · yellow: saved values · purple: PC · blue: active registers · dashed arrows: pointers
